# EliteEquipment Separate Boots: ValheimAssets NativeSplit_v001 (+ Bronze v004, Leather, Troll, Caller, Ask, Embla, EitrWeave v002 paint).
# Coordinates only, top-down texel rows. faces <set> <total> <first-last,...>: the boots triangles of the
# leggings mesh; legs <set> <total> <first-last,...>: those of them the trousers draw too (Lox v002). paint <set> <size> <boundary>: rows from <boundary> down are the boots (Rag: none). c x y sx sy: RGB from
# the native texel; f: RGB from it and opaque; b x y sx sy w: RGB blended toward it by w (after every c and f).
paint Rag 256 256
paint Leather 256 76
